title: The Parade Under the Pavement
description: At dusk on St. Patrick’s Day, a fiddle tune rises through the rain-wet stones. Beneath the village lane, a lantern parade has the whole road to itself.
alt: An emerald crack in a wet cobblestone lane reveals lantern-lit fiddlers, pipers and a drummer walking beneath an Irish village at dusk.
pairing: St. Patrick’s Day × an underground fairy parade
